# Bedrock

> Bedrock is a personal cloud for small TypeScript apps called pebbles. Bun runs each pebble in its own process, with SQLite, Google login, reactive queries, file storage, jobs, application sockets and services. Use the shipped AGENTS.md as the complete pebble author guide.

## Minimal pebble.ts

```ts
import { definePebble, query } from "bedrock";

export default definePebble({
  name: "hello",
  access: "public",
  queries: {
    hello: query(() => ({ message: "Hello from Bedrock" })),
  },
});
```

## Author guide

- [A complete pebble](AGENTS.md#a-complete-pebble): runnable example and setup.
- [Configuration and functions](AGENTS.md#configuration-and-functions): config, context and HTTP functions.
- [Schema and migrations](AGENTS.md#schema-and-migrations): database changes, rollback and detached work.
- [Authentication, authorization and trust](AGENTS.md#authentication-authorization-and-trust): access policies and pebble tokens.
- [Live queries and explicit invalidation](AGENTS.md#live-queries-and-explicit-invalidation): subscriptions and write tracking.
- [Storage](AGENTS.md#storage): buckets, uploads and file policies.
- [Jobs](AGENTS.md#jobs): cron and manual runs.
- [Composition](AGENTS.md#composition): share schema/routes/jobs/sockets/services maps.
- [Application sockets and long-lived services](AGENTS.md#application-sockets-and-long-lived-services): protocols and lifecycle.
- [Browser client and React](AGENTS.md#browser-client-and-react): client, hooks, UI and release freshness.
- [Host operations and backups](AGENTS.md#host-operations-and-backups): deploy, tunnel, service and recovery.
- [Secrets, scoped deploy tokens and service tokens](AGENTS.md#secrets-scoped-deploy-tokens-and-service-tokens): credentials and delegated administration.
- [Common mistakes](AGENTS.md#common-mistakes): author checks.

## Key CLI commands

```sh
bedrock new hello --template minimal
bedrock dev
bedrock db generate
bedrock db plan
bedrock db migrate
bedrock setup
bedrock login example.com
bedrock deploy
bedrock status
bedrock logs hello
bedrock jobs ls hello
bedrock jobs run hello refresh
bedrock secrets set hello API_TOKEN --restart
bedrock token ls
bedrock backup run hello
bedrock backup ls hello
bedrock rollback hello
```

CLI commands support --json; destructive commands require --yes.
